philosophical_framing.core_premise: Borders are historical, colonial, and political constructs. The failure to build continental free movement is political and bureaucratic, not imaginative. Treaties are secondary perishable firmware; human and ecological movement is primary reality.

ecowas.name: Economic Community of West African States
ecowas.free_movement_protocol: 1979 Protocol on Free Movement of Persons, Right of Residence and Establishment (A/P.1/5/79)

phases.phase_1_entry: Article 2: Right of entry without visa for all ECOWAS citizens for up to 90 days with valid travel document and international health certificate (Yellow Fever).
phases.phase_2_residence: Right of residence for citizens to seek and take up employment (enacted 1986).
phases.phase_3_establishment: Right to establish enterprise and carry out commercial activities (enacted 1990).

ecowas.trade_scheme: ECOWAS Trade Liberalization Scheme (ETLS): 0% customs tariff on unprocessed agricultural produce and local artisanal handicrafts.
ecowas.known_bureaucratic_friction: Informal checkpoint extortion, arbitrary demands for extra-legal 'entry stamps', non-recognition of national ID cards by local officers.

african_union.name: African Union (AU)
african_union.protocol_free_movement: AU Protocol to the Treaty Establishing the African Economic Community Relating to Free Movement of Persons, Right of Residence and Right of Establishment (2018)

articles.article_3_principles: Free movement of persons, right of residence, and right of establishment across all AU member states without discrimination.
articles.article_5_entry: Progressive abolition of visa requirements; 90-day visa-free entry.
articles.article_10_african_passport: Issuance of the official African Union Passport to facilitate unhindered continental travel.

african_union.afcfta: African Continental Free Trade Area (2018): Elimination of 90% of tariffs on intra-African goods, simplified trade regime for small cross-border traders.
african_union.bamako_convention: Bamako Convention (1991/1998): Absolute prohibition of import into Africa of hazardous, toxic, radioactive, or e-waste.

aes.name: Alliance of Sahel States (L'Alliance des États du Sahel - Burkina Faso, Mali, Niger)

mobility_directives.aes_unified_passport: Biometric, unified AES Confederation Passport ensuring unrestricted, visa-free passage across Mali, Burkina Faso, and Niger.
mobility_directives.free_movement_zone: Sovereign Sahelian mobility corridor prioritizing regional security, shared customs tariffs, and mutual recognition of civil status.

aes.transition_status: Withdrawal from ECOWAS effective January 2025; transitional reciprocal entry for neighboring West African citizens under ongoing bilateral management.

sentinel_1_sar.empirical_diagnosis: Severe physical customs bottlenecking contradicting ETLS priority clearance.

opencellid_rf_bleed.empirical_proof: Electromagnetic data naturally crosses border without passport or checkpoint friction.
